tldr: 台積電第三季獲利創高，稅後淨利7,630億元、EPS 29.43元，營收年增約50.9%。
台股重挫3.41%（跌1,656點）收46,970點，美CPI升溫與晶片股重挫拖累買盤，外資連七日賣超。
台積電財測第四季營收上看523至543億美元，2奈米比重升向8%，AI供應鏈獲利循環延續。
AI融資疑慮引爆全球科技股賣壓，SK海力士跌逾10%，輝達、超微、戴爾同步走弱，20檔AI晶片股本週市值蒸發逾1兆美元。
台灣央行利率連10季維持2%、上修2026年成長率至11.48%，美國聯準會則升息一碼至3.75%至4%。

items.title_zh: 台積電Q3獲利創高 EPS 29.43元、營收年增50.9%
items.title_en: TSMC reports record Q3 profit with EPS of NT$29.43 as AI demand drives revenue up 50.9%
items.summary_zh: 台積電法說會公布第三季財報，合併營收約1兆4,942億元，季增17.6%、年增50.9%；稅後淨利7,630.6億元，每股盈餘29.43元，三項數字同創歷史新高。毛利率因2奈米量產爬坡微降至66.4%。在AI需求帶動下，獲利優於財測上緣，為權值最重的台積電提供基本面支撐，有助在大盤回檔之際穩定市場對電子權值股的信心與資金輪動方向。
items.summary_en: TSMC unveiled third-quarter results at its earnings call, reporting consolidated revenue of about NT$1.494tn (up 17.6% sequentially and 50.9% on the year), net profit of NT$763.1bn and EPS of NT$29.43—all record highs. Gross margin eased to 66.4% as the 2nm node ramped. The scale of the AI-led beat should anchor sentiment toward Taiwan's most heavily weighted stock even amid a broad market pullback.

items.title_zh: 台股重挫3.41% 美CPI與晶片股賣壓拖累
items.title_en: Taiwan shares slump 3.41% as US CPI and chip-stock rout hit sentiment
items.summary_zh: 加權指數大跌1,655.96點、跌幅3.41%，收46,969.87點，成交量放大至約1.31兆元。美國9月CPI高於預期、費城半導體指數重挫，壓抑AI與晶片類股；外資同步連續第七個交易日賣超，法人保守氣氛濃厚。台積電在法說會前相對抗跌，為指數提供部分支撐，盤面資金集中於權值股與防禦性族群，短線須留意高檔震盪與量能變化。
items.summary_en: The benchmark TAIEX tumbled 1,655.96 points, or 3.41%, to close at 46,969.87, with turnover swelling to about NT$1.31tn. A hotter-than-expected US September CPI and a sharp fall in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index pressured AI and chip names, while foreign investors extended net selling to a seventh straight session. TSMC proved relatively resilient into its earnings call, limiting the index's downside.

items.title_zh: 台積電財測Q4營收上看543億美元 2奈米比重升向8%
items.title_en: TSMC guides Q4 revenue to US$52.3–54.3bn as 2nm climbs toward 8% of wafer sales
items.summary_zh: 台積電公布第三季財報同時給出第四季財測，營收預估523至543億美元，毛利率65%至67%、營益率56.5%至58.5%（匯率假設31.8元兌1美元）。2奈米（N2）製程營收比重提升至約8%，高效能運算（HPC）占比接近七成，顯示AI與先進製程需求仍是晶圓代工供應鏈主要動能。先進封裝CoWoS與2奈米放量進度，將牽動明年台廠設備、材料與封測業者的接單與產能規劃。
items.summary_en: Alongside record Q3 results, TSMC guided fourth-quarter revenue to US$52.3–54.3bn with gross margin of 65–67% and operating margin of 56.5–58.5% (assuming NT$31.8 per US dollar). The 2nm (N2) node lifted its revenue contribution to around 8%, while high-performance computing accounted for close to 70% of sales, underscoring that AI and advanced-node demand remains the main engine for the chip supply chain.

items.title_zh: 記憶體上行循環延續 伺服器DDR5報價走高、台廠擴大資本支出
items.title_en: Memory up-cycle extends as server DDR5 prices climb and makers lift capex
items.summary_zh: 產業報導指出，AI需求帶動記憶體漲價循環延續，第三季伺服器DDR5合約價估季增10%至20%，部分預估DRAM漲幅上看約30%。SK海力士認為通用型DRAM供給將落後需求至2028年；南亞科計畫將2026年資本支出提高至約500億元。面對記憶體漲價，鴻海等台廠伺服器業者將部分專案改採寄售模式以降低毛利率稀釋，牽動AI伺服器與記憶體供應鏈營運動能與獲利結構。
items.summary_en: Industry reports point to a sustained AI-driven memory up-cycle, with third-quarter server DDR5 contract prices seen rising 10–20% and some forecasts putting DRAM gains near 30%. SK Hynix expects commodity DRAM supply to trail demand until 2028, and Nanya Technology plans to raise 2026 capex to about NT$50bn. Taiwanese server and component makers such as Hon Hai are shifting some projects to consignment models to cushion margin dilution.

items.title_zh: 壽險接軌IFRS 17與新清償制度 匯率避險成本壓力待解
items.title_en: Life insurers navigate IFRS 17 and new solvency regime amid FX-hedging cost pressure
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業2026年起接軌IFRS 17與新一代清償能力制度（ICS），推動商品設計轉向保障型、去長期保證化。新台幣走強使匯率避險成本攀升、侵蝕獲利，壽險公會研議改善會計處理機制；金管會同步採行過渡措施，包括資本適足率採匯率均價制度，以緩解短期衝擊。制度轉換牽動壽險業資產配置、避險策略與財報表現，為金融業中後續須密切觀察的結構性議題。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life insurance sector is operating under IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency (ICS) framework adopted in 2026, reshaping product design toward protection-type policies and away from long-term guarantees. A strong New Taiwan dollar has lifted currency-hedging costs and eroded profits, prompting the industry association to seek accounting relief, while regulators apply transitional measures such as an averaged exchange-rate basis for capital-adequacy calculations.

items.title_zh: 金管會2026八大新制 強化揭露、推動股東會數位化
items.title_en: FSC's 2026 reform package tightens disclosure and digitalises shareholder meetings
items.summary_zh: 金管會2026年八大新制涵蓋證券與保險。上市櫃公司須提前上傳股東會議事手冊與年報（分別提前至30天、14天），自3月底起可透過電子平台線上領取非實體股東會紀念品；保險業月營收申報期限由每月10日延後至15日。新制旨在提升資訊揭露品質、作業效率與投資人便利性，並延續股東會電子化與永續揭露接軌方向，業者須配合調整申報與作業流程，為資本市場制度面帶來一波調整。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission's eight measures for 2026 span securities and insurance. Listed companies must upload meeting handbooks and annual reports earlier (30 and 14 days ahead), an e-platform lets shareholders claim non-physical meeting gifts online from end-March, and insurers' monthly revenue filing deadline moves from the 10th to the 15th. The package aims to improve transparency, efficiency and investor convenience across capital markets.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管規模逼近2.08兆元 銀行擴大私人銀行布局
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth AUM nears NT$2.08tn as banks expand private-banking offerings
items.summary_zh: 業界引述金管會數據指出，台灣高資產財富管理業務資產規模（AUM）約達2兆767億元，年增約五成。凱基銀行規劃推出門檻新台幣1億元的私人銀行會員，其他業者亦擴充國外股票、ETF與境外結構型商品平台。高資產客戶需求正從單純配置投資商品，轉向資產負債整合管理、資產保全與家族傳承，帶動銀行財富管理與信託、私銀業務加速升級，成為金融業爭取高端客群的重要戰場。
items.summary_en: Citing FSC data, industry reports say assets under management in Taiwan's high-net-worth wealth business reached about NT$2.08tn, up roughly 50% year-on-year. KGI Bank plans a private-banking membership with a NT$100m threshold, while peers broaden overseas equity, ETF and offshore structured-product platforms. Demand is shifting from single-product allocation toward integrated asset-liability management, wealth preservation and family succession.

items.title_zh: 期交所獎勵新台幣結構型商品 深化高資產財管
items.title_en: TAIFEX incentive scheme spurs NT-denominated structured products for wealthy clients
items.summary_zh: 為配合政府推動亞洲資產管理中心政策，台灣期貨交易所續辦高資產客戶財富管理業務獎勵活動，鼓勵銀行發行新臺幣計價結構型商品，每檔商品須達1億元實際銷售實績方可申請。台新銀行發行連結台股的非保本型結構型商品，並以個股期貨避險，獲得獎勵。此類活動有助壯大本土結構型商品市場、提升高資產客戶在台投資誘因，並推動財富管理商品多元化與避險工具運用。
items.summary_en: To support Taiwan's push to become an Asian asset-management hub, the Taiwan Futures Exchange has continued an incentive programme rewarding banks that issue NT dollar-denominated structured products for high-net-worth clients, with each qualifying product required to achieve NT$100m in actual sales. Taishin Bank, which issued a non-principal-guaranteed structured note linked to Taiwan equities and hedged via single-stock futures, was among the award recipients.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法三讀 財政部研擬子法規配套
items.title_en: Legislature overhauls estate-tax basis as Finance Ministry drafts implementing rules
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過以「擬制遺產課稅」方式課徵遺產稅，財政部表示正研擬修正遺贈稅法施行細則等子法規，並將同步調整申報書表與線上申辦系統。總統公布修正條文後，財政部將加強宣導，以利徵納依循。新制聚焦強化對生前財產移轉的反避稅認定，牽動高資產族群的傳承與贈與規劃；實際施行日期與細節仍待子法與公告確認，納稅人宜留意後續法規進度與申報作業調整。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's legislature passed amendments shifting estate taxation toward a "deemed-estate" basis, prompting the Ministry of Finance to revise sub-regulations such as the enforcement rules of the Estate and Gift Tax Act and to adjust filing forms and online systems. The ministry says it will step up public guidance once the president promulgates the changes, aiming to tighten anti-avoidance treatment of asset transfers ahead of death while easing compliance.

items.title_zh: 2026綜所稅調整 長照扣除額提高、基本生活費上調
items.title_en: 2026 income-tax relief raises long-term-care and basic-living deductions
items.summary_zh: 2026年度綜所稅調整，長期照顧特別扣除額由每人12萬元提高至18萬元，基本生活費則調整為21.3萬元；財政部並就網路創作者、網紅的課稅性質與扣繳義務發布作業規範。相關調整有助減輕長照家庭負擔，並使數位經濟所得課稅更明確。納稅人宜將提高後的扣除額與門檻納入年度報稅與節稅規劃，並留意線上申辦與扣繳相關作業變動，以免影響權益。
items.summary_en: For the 2026 tax year, Taiwan lifts the special deduction for long-term care from NT$120,000 to NT$180,000 per person, while the basic living expense rises to NT$213,000. Authorities have also clarified income-tax treatment and withholding obligations for online creators and influencers. The adjustments ease the burden on caregiving households and sharpen rules for digital-economy income, and taxpayers should factor the higher thresholds into year-end planning.

items.title_zh: 台灣央行利率連10季不動 大幅上修成長預測
items.title_en: Taiwan's central bank holds rates for a 10th straight quarter and lifts growth forecast
items.summary_zh: 中央銀行9月理監事會維持政策利率2%，為連續第10季按兵不動，並未跟進美國聯準會動作。央行受AI相關半導體出口需求帶動，將2026年經濟成長率預估由6月的9.45%大幅上修至11.48%，並將今年CPI年增率預估小幅調高至2.03%。總裁楊金龍釋出貨幣操作仍朝緊縮方向的訊號。強勁出口與溫和通膨並存，使央行在維持利率的同時保留政策彈性，後續升息與否牽動資金與匯率走向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank kept its policy rate at 2% at its September board meeting, the tenth consecutive quarter on hold, and declined to follow the US Federal Reserve. It sharply raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 11.48% from 9.45%, driven by AI-related semiconductor export demand, while nudging its 2026 CPI projection up to 2.03%. Governor Yang Chin-long signalled policy is still leaning toward tightening.

items.title_zh: 美聯準會逾三年來首度升息 通膨居高不下
items.title_en: Fed delivers first rate hike in over three years as US inflation runs hot
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會將基準利率調升一碼至3.75%至4%區間，為逾三年來首度升息，背景是9月整體CPI年增3.7%、生產者物價（PPI）年增6.3%，均高於市場預期。利率期貨顯示，交易員目前預估10月27至28日會議按兵不動的機率約67%，部分官員表示可能等待更明朗的數據再行動。美國通膨僵固與升息路徑，持續牽動全球資金流向、美元與新興市場風險性資產表現。
items.summary_en: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate by a quarter point to a 3.75%–4% target range, its first hike in more than three years, after September headline CPI rose 3.7% year-on-year and producer prices jumped 6.3%, both above forecasts. Traders now see about a 67% chance the Fed holds at its Oct 27–28 meeting, with officials signalling they may wait for more clarity.

items.title_zh: 美通膨升溫、AI融資疑慮 全球股市劇烈震盪晶片股重挫
items.title_en: Global markets whipsawed as hot US inflation and AI-funding fears spark chip rout
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，美國9月通膨數據高於預期、重燃聯準會緊縮憂慮，費城半導體指數重挫，AI與晶片權值股領跌，全球科技股同步修正。賣壓外溢亞股，壓抑記憶體族群與台股電子權值股表現。市場評論將AI基礎建設融資風險視為核心疑慮，使近期全球股市投資氣氛轉趨脆弱，資金轉向防禦性資產，後續仍須觀察通膨、升息路徑與AI資本支出動向對風險性資產的影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media highlighted a sharp global tech sell-off after hotter-than-expected US September inflation revived Fed tightening worries, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbling and AI and chip heavyweights leading losses. The rout spilled into Asia, pressuring memory names and Taiwan's weighting-heavy electronics stocks. Commentary flagged AI-infrastructure financing risk as a central concern, keeping global equity sentiment fragile into the latest sessions.

items.title_zh: 美大型銀行財報分歧 摩根大通遜色、高盛與大摩優於預期
items.title_en: US big-bank earnings diverge as JPMorgan misses while Goldman and Morgan Stanley beat
items.summary_zh: 美國大型銀行第三季財報表現分歧：摩根大通營收與每股盈餘低於市場預期，但上修2026年淨利息收入展望；高盛與摩根士丹利則因交易與投資銀行動能強勁優於預期，其中大摩以股票交易為主要成長引擎。財報為美國消費與資本市場健康度提供觀察指標。隨財報季加速，市場聚焦銀行獲利品質、放款與交易收入趨勢，作為研判美國經濟與風險胃納的重要依據。
items.summary_en: Third-quarter results from major US banks were mixed: JPMorgan's revenue and EPS came in below forecasts though it raised 2026 net-interest-income guidance, while Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley beat estimates on strong trading and investment-banking momentum. Equities trading was a key driver at Morgan Stanley. The results offered a read on US consumer and capital-markets health as earnings season picked up pace.

items.title_zh: 輝達、超微、戴爾重挫 AI融資疑慮引爆全球科技股賣壓（2026-10-15）
items.title_en: Nvidia, AMD, Dell sink in global tech rout on AI funding worries (2026-10-15)
items.summary_zh: 全球科技股下挫，市場對AI基礎建設融資的疑慮加深，輝達、超微、英特爾與戴爾同步走弱，南韓SK海力士暴跌逾10%、三星下跌8.73%。全球市值最高的20檔AI與半導體股本週合計蒸發逾1兆美元。博通執行長警告，資金取得恐成為AI建置的下一個瓶頸，顯示AI投資熱潮的融資與估值風險正受到重新檢視。
items.summary_en: Global technology stocks slid as fears over AI-infrastructure financing deepened, with Nvidia, AMD, Intel and Dell falling and South Korea's SK Hynix plunging more than 10% while Samsung dropped 8.73%. Collectively, 20 of the most valuable global AI and semiconductor stocks shed over $1 trillion this week. Broadcom's CEO warned access to capital could become the next constraint on the AI buildout.

items.title_zh: 美元自18個月高點回落 公債殖利率走低、升息押注降溫（2026-10-15）
items.title_en: Dollar pulls back from 18-month high as Treasury yields fall and Fed hike bets ease (2026-10-15)
items.summary_zh: 美元自18個月高點回落，美國公債殖利率下滑，交易員在聯準會升息一碼至3.75%至4%區間後，調降對進一步緊縮的押注。市場目前預估10月下旬會議按兵不動的機率約67%，部分官員釋出將等待通膨數據更明朗再行動的訊號。美元與殖利率走勢牽動全球資金流向，對新興市場貨幣與風險性資產帶來喘息空間。
items.summary_en: The US dollar retreated from an 18-month high as Treasury yields fell and traders pared bets on further Fed tightening following the central bank's quarter-point hike to a 3.75%–4% range. Markets now price roughly a 67% chance the Fed holds at its late-October meeting, with officials signalling they may await more clarity on inflation before acting again.

items.title_zh: 油價漲跌互見 中東情勢使供給風險續受關注（2026-10-15）
items.title_en: Oil prices mixed as Middle East tensions keep supply risk in focus (2026-10-15)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價維持高檔，沙烏地阿拉伯與伊朗支持的青年運動（Houthi）衝突升溫。美國西德州中級原油（WTI）期貨上漲約3%、每桶漲2.88美元至約97.97美元；布蘭特12月期貨則小跌14美分、收105.92美元。國際能源署（IEA）警告市場供給受限，加上傳出沙國設施遭攻擊與荷姆茲海峽航運受擾，使供給風險溢價持續，牽動全球通膨與能源類股表現。
items.summary_en: Crude remained elevated amid escalating conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi forces. US WTI futures gained about 3%, or $2.88, to settle near $97.97 a barrel, while Brent for December slipped 14 cents to settle at $105.92. The IEA warned of market constraints, and reports of attacks on Saudi facilities and shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz kept supply-risk premiums in play.

items.title_zh: 金價維持高檔 投資人權衡通膨與利率路徑（2026-10-15）
items.title_en: Gold holds near elevated levels as investors weigh inflation and rate path (2026-10-15)
items.summary_zh: 現貨黃金報每盎司約4,150美元，高於一週前的約4,096美元，投資人在美國通膨升溫、利率展望偏緊，與中東情勢推升避險需求之間權衡。金價9月自1月逾5,500美元的歷史高點回落逾8%。摩根士丹利仍將黃金列為首選原物料，目標價看2027年第二季每盎司5,000美元。通膨僵固與地緣風險使黃金在高檔震盪，續為資產配置關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Spot gold traded around $4,150 an ounce, up from about $4,096 a week earlier, as investors balanced hot US inflation and a firmer rate outlook against safe-haven demand amid Middle East tensions. Gold had pulled back more than 8% in September from a January record above $5,500. Morgan Stanley still lists gold as its top commodity pick, targeting $5,000 an ounce by the second quarter of 2027.
